programme.title: Memoirs of a Geisha
programme.desc: In 1929 an impoverished nine-year-old named Chiyo from a fishing village is sold to a geisha house in Kyoto's Gion district and subjected to cruel treatment from the owners and the head geisha Hatsumomo. Her stunning beauty attracts the vindictive jealousy of Hatsumomo, until she is rescued by and taken under the wing of Hatsumomo's bitter rival, Mameha. Under Mameha's mentorship, Chiyo becomes the geisha Sayuri, trained in all the artistic and social skills a geisha must master in order to survive in her society. As a renowned geisha she enters a society of wealth, privilege, and political intrigue. As the Second World War looms, Japan and the geisha's world are forever changed by the onslaught of history.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: In 1593, struggling playwright Will Shakespeare finds inspiration and love with Lady Viola, who disguises as a man to act in his play.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E5 Movie Show 1988 Ep 5 An episode featuring Christian Bale discussing his role in Empire of the Sun and Wendy Hughes reflecting on portraying a prostitute in Warm Nights on a Slow Moving Train.

programme.title: Hotel Salvation
programme.desc: Rajiv is forced to drop everything in order to accommodate his father's last and bizarre wish to travel to Varanasi to attain salvation. The trip that follows forces the duo to re-engage with each other and the world around them in this heart-warming comedy.

programme.title: Tokyo Story
programme.desc: An elderly couple travels from the countryside to Tokyo to visit their grown children, only to find them busy and emotionally distant. As quiet disappointments surface, a family tragedy reveals the costs of modern life and changing values. A gentle, deeply moving classic.

programme.title: The Longest Week
programme.desc: Left broke and homeless by his wealthy parents' divorce, a young man moves in with an old friend and finally meets the woman of his dreams.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: In 1593, struggling playwright Will Shakespeare finds inspiration and love with Lady Viola, who disguises as a man to act in his play.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E6 Movie Show 1988 Ep 6 Margaret and David review Slamdance, Couch Trip, Overboard, Repentance and doco Cannibal Tours, with film news, festival highlights and the premiere of Pandemonium.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: S12 E8 Joseph Cotten Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the 'golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: Limelight
programme.desc: Depressed over her failed dance career, a despondent ballerina attempts to take her own life, only to be rescued by an impoverished, once-famous stage clown. The comedian helps revive the dancer's health and prospects, and in the process recovers his own self-esteem as well. Directed by and starring Charlie Chaplin. Also stars Claire Bloom, Nigel Bruce and Buster Keaton.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Crooked House
programme.desc: When a wealthy tycoon is poisoned in his own bed, Detective Charles Hayward is invited to solve the gruesome crime. He is shocked to discover that one of the key suspects is the tycoon's beautiful granddaughter Sophia, his former lover. Hayward must keep a clear head to navigate Sophia and the rest of her hostile family in a case where nobody is above suspicion. Stars Max Irons and Stefanie Martini.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock and George Clooney star in Gravity, a thriller where two astronauts are stranded in space after their shuttle is destroyed. Running out of oxygen, they must fight to survive.

programme.title: Misery
programme.desc: The story of best-selling author, Paul Sheldon, who is on his way back home after finishing his latest novel. Meet Annie Wilkes, Paul's self-proclaimed number one fan, who takes it upon herself to nurse him back to health. After reading through one of his manuscripts, however, all hell breaks loose and nothing is ever the same again. Stars James Caan and Kathy Bates.

programme.title: Thelma & Louise
programme.desc: In one of the greatest road movies of all time, two women embark on a crime spree across the American south-west.

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: A neurologist and an old friend head to a deserted seaside town to identify a body. Strange nights and buried emotions turn a simple task into something unsettling and profound.

programme.title: The Girlfriend Experience
programme.desc: A drama set in the days leading up to the 2008 Presidential election, and centred on a high-end Manhattan call girl meeting the challenges of her boyfriend, her clients, and her work.

programme.title: Limelight
programme.desc: Depressed over her failed dance career, a despondent ballerina attempts to take her own life, only to be rescued by an impoverished, once-famous stage clown. The comedian helps revive the dancer's health and prospects, and in the process recovers his own self-esteem as well. Directed by and starring Charlie Chaplin. Also stars Claire Bloom, Nigel Bruce and Buster Keaton.

programme.title: Discovering Film

programme.title: In a Land that no Longer Exists
programme.desc: Exploring fashion in the former GDR, this film highlights iconic Sibylle magazine, state brand Exquisit, and the underground creative subculture behind East Germany's style scene.

programme.title: Marinette
programme.desc: Marinette tells the story of pioneering French female soccer star Marinette Pichon. Filmmaker Virginie Verrier's biopic traces the athlete's battle to earn her homeland's respect.

programme.title: The Movie Show

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: Black Swan follows the story of Nina, a ballerina in a New York City ballet company whose life, like all those in her profession, is completely consumed with dance. She lives with her retired ballerina mother, Erica, who zealously supports her daughter's professional ambition. When artistic director Thomas Leroy decides to replace prima ballerina Beth MacIntyre for the opening production of their new season, Swan Lake, Nina is his first choice. But Nina has competition - a new dancer, Lily, who impresses Leroy as well. Swan Lake requires a dancer who can play both the White Swan with innocence and grace, and the Black Swan, who represents guile and sensuality. Nina fits the White Swan role perfectly but Lily is the personification of the Black Swan. As the two young dancers expand their rivalry into a twisted friendship, Nina begins to get more in touch with her dark side with a recklessness that threatens to destroy her.

programme.title: Memoirs of a Geisha
programme.desc: In 1929 an impoverished nine-year-old named Chiyo from a fishing village is sold to a geisha house in Kyoto's Gion district and subjected to cruel treatment from the owners and the head geisha Hatsumomo. Her stunning beauty attracts the vindictive jealousy of Hatsumomo, until she is rescued by and taken under the wing of Hatsumomo's bitter rival, Mameha. Under Mameha's mentorship, Chiyo becomes the geisha Sayuri, trained in all the artistic and social skills a geisha must master in order to survive in her society. As a renowned geisha she enters a society of wealth, privilege, and political intrigue. As the Second World War looms, Japan and the geisha's world are forever changed by the onslaught of history.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: In 1593, struggling playwright Will Shakespeare finds inspiration and love with Lady Viola, who disguises as a man to act in his play.

programme.title: The Movie Show

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: Black Swan follows the story of Nina, a ballerina in a New York City ballet company whose life, like all those in her profession, is completely consumed with dance. She lives with her retired ballerina mother, Erica, who zealously supports her daughter's professional ambition. When artistic director Thomas Leroy decides to replace prima ballerina Beth MacIntyre for the opening production of their new season, Swan Lake, Nina is his first choice. But Nina has competition - a new dancer, Lily, who impresses Leroy as well. Swan Lake requires a dancer who can play both the White Swan with innocence and grace, and the Black Swan, who represents guile and sensuality. Nina fits the White Swan role perfectly but Lily is the personification of the Black Swan. As the two young dancers expand their rivalry into a twisted friendship, Nina begins to get more in touch with her dark side with a recklessness that threatens to destroy her.

programme.desc: Black Swan follows the story of Nina, a ballerina in a New York City ballet company whose life, like all those in her profession, is completely consumed with dance. She lives with her retired ballerina mother, Erica, who zealously supports her daughter's professional ambition. When artistic director Thomas Leroy decides to replace prima ballerina Beth MacIntyre for the opening production of their new season, Swan Lake, Nina is his first choice. But Nina has competition - a new dancer, Lily, who impresses Leroy as well. Swan Lake requires a dancer who can play both the White Swan with innocence and grace, and the Black Swan, who represents guile and sensuality. Nina fits the White Swan role perfectly but Lily is the personification of the Black Swan. programme.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice of Italy
programme.desc: S1 E7 Fresh from the Lagoon Sophie meets a mussel farmer on the lagoon at Taranto. At home she prepares a mussel, potato and rice gratin and cooks an octopus stew for her guests at the trulli.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Spain
programme.desc: S1 E3 Rick is invited to a beautiful beach party at La Pelosa, where everyone gets stuck into preparing lunch. Continuing his journey through the spectacular countryside, far removed from the high-rise holiday destinations of the Costa Brava, he seeks out an old mill, El Moli, a restaurant and a magical place his boyhood friend Mark told him about years ago.

programme.title: Strait to the Plate

programme.title: Sara's Istanbul Delights

programme.desc: S7 E9 Cultured Comforts It is all about stress-free cooking for a holiday celebration. Lidia makes marinated mushrooms, vin brule, an Italian version of mulled wine and turkey breast with apricots.

programme.title: Memoirs of a Geisha
programme.desc: In 1929 an impoverished nine-year-old named Chiyo from a fishing village is sold to a geisha house in Kyoto's Gion district and subjected to cruel treatment from the owners and the head geisha Hatsumomo. Her stunning beauty attracts the vindictive jealousy of Hatsumomo, until she is rescued by and taken under the wing of Hatsumomo's bitter rival, Mameha. Under Mameha's mentorship, Chiyo becomes the geisha Sayuri, trained in all the artistic and social skills a geisha must master in order to survive in her society. As a renowned geisha she enters a society of wealth, privilege, and political intrigue. As the Second World War looms, Japan and the geisha's world are forever changed by the onslaught of history.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: In 1593, struggling playwright Will Shakespeare finds inspiration and love with Lady Viola, who disguises as a man to act in his play.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E5 Movie Show 1988 Ep 5 An episode featuring Christian Bale discussing his role in Empire of the Sun and Wendy Hughes reflecting on portraying a prostitute in Warm Nights on a Slow Moving Train.

programme.title: Hotel Salvation
programme.desc: Rajiv is forced to drop everything in order to accommodate his father's last and bizarre wish to travel to Varanasi to attain salvation. The trip that follows forces the duo to re-engage with each other and the world around them in this heart-warming comedy.

programme.title: Tokyo Story
programme.desc: An elderly couple travels from the countryside to Tokyo to visit their grown children, only to find them busy and emotionally distant. As quiet disappointments surface, a family tragedy reveals the costs of modern life and changing values. A gentle, deeply moving classic.

programme.title: The Longest Week
programme.desc: Left broke and homeless by his wealthy parents' divorce, a young man moves in with an old friend and finally meets the woman of his dreams.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: In 1593, struggling playwright Will Shakespeare finds inspiration and love with Lady Viola, who disguises as a man to act in his play.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E6 Movie Show 1988 Ep 6 Margaret and David review Slamdance, Couch Trip, Overboard, Repentance and doco Cannibal Tours, with film news, festival highlights and the premiere of Pandemonium.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: S12 E8 Joseph Cotten Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the 'golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: Limelight
programme.desc: Depressed over her failed dance career, a despondent ballerina attempts to take her own life, only to be rescued by an impoverished, once-famous stage clown. The comedian helps revive the dancer's health and prospects, and in the process recovers his own self-esteem as well. Directed by and starring Charlie Chaplin. Also stars Claire Bloom, Nigel Bruce and Buster Keaton.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Crooked House
programme.desc: When a wealthy tycoon is poisoned in his own bed, Detective Charles Hayward is invited to solve the gruesome crime. He is shocked to discover that one of the key suspects is the tycoon's beautiful granddaughter Sophia, his former lover. Hayward must keep a clear head to navigate Sophia and the rest of her hostile family in a case where nobody is above suspicion. Stars Max Irons and Stefanie Martini.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock and George Clooney star in Gravity, a thriller where two astronauts are stranded in space after their shuttle is destroyed. Running out of oxygen, they must fight to survive.

programme.title: Misery
programme.desc: The story of best-selling author, Paul Sheldon, who is on his way back home after finishing his latest novel. Meet Annie Wilkes, Paul's self-proclaimed number one fan, who takes it upon herself to nurse him back to health. After reading through one of his manuscripts, however, all hell breaks loose and nothing is ever the same again. Stars James Caan and Kathy Bates.

programme.title: Thelma & Louise
programme.desc: In one of the greatest road movies of all time, two women embark on a crime spree across the American south-west.

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: A neurologist and an old friend head to a deserted seaside town to identify a body. Strange nights and buried emotions turn a simple task into something unsettling and profound.

programme.title: The Girlfriend Experience
programme.desc: A drama set in the days leading up to the 2008 Presidential election, and centred on a high-end Manhattan call girl meeting the challenges of her boyfriend, her clients, and her work.

programme.desc: Exploring fashion in the former GDR, this film highlights iconic Sibylle magazine, state brand Exquisit, and the underground creative subculture behind East Germany's style scene.

programme.title: Marinette
programme.desc: Marinette tells the story of pioneering French female soccer star Marinette Pichon. Filmmaker Virginie Verrier's biopic traces the athlete's battle to earn her homeland's respect.

programme.title: The Remains of the Day
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins plays a devoted English butler reflecting on a lifetime of service, lost love, and loyalty as he realizes too late the cost of his blind duty.

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: Black Swan follows the story of Nina, a ballerina in a New York City ballet company whose life, like all those in her profession, is completely consumed with dance. She lives with her retired ballerina mother, Erica, who zealously supports her daughter's professional ambition. When artistic director Thomas Leroy decides to replace prima ballerina Beth MacIntyre for the opening production of their new season, Swan Lake, Nina is his first choice. But Nina has competition - a new dancer, Lily, who impresses Leroy as well. Swan Lake requires a dancer who can play both the White Swan with innocence and grace, and the Black Swan, who represents guile and sensuality. Nina fits the White Swan role perfectly but Lily is the personification of the Black Swan. As the two young dancers expand their rivalry into a twisted friendship, Nina begins to get more in touch with her dark side with a recklessness that threatens to destroy her.

programme.title: The Whale

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: Black Swan follows the story of Nina, a ballerina in a New York City ballet company whose life, like all those in her profession, is completely consumed with dance. She lives with her retired ballerina mother, Erica, who zealously supports her daughter's professional ambition. When artistic director Thomas Leroy decides to replace prima ballerina Beth MacIntyre for the opening production of their new season, Swan Lake, Nina is his first choice. But Nina has competition - a new dancer, Lily, who impresses Leroy as well. Swan Lake requires a dancer who can play both the White Swan with innocence and grace, and the Black Swan, who represents guile and sensuality. Nina fits the White Swan role perfectly but Lily is the personification of the Black Swan. As the two young dancers expand their rivalry into a twisted friendship, Nina begins to get more in touch with her dark side with a recklessness that threatens to destroy her.

programme.title: Memoirs of a Geisha
programme.desc: In 1929 an impoverished nine-year-old named Chiyo from a fishing village is sold to a geisha house in Kyoto's Gion district and subjected to cruel treatment from the owners and the head geisha Hatsumomo. Her stunning beauty attracts the vindictive jealousy of Hatsumomo, until she is rescued by and taken under the wing of Hatsumomo's bitter rival, Mameha. Under Mameha's mentorship, Chiyo becomes the geisha Sayuri, trained in all the artistic and social skills a geisha must master in order to survive in her society. As a renowned geisha she enters a society of wealth, privilege, and political intrigue. As the Second World War looms, Japan and the geisha's world are forever changed by the onslaught of history.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: In 1593, struggling playwright Will Shakespeare finds inspiration and love with Lady Viola, who disguises as a man to act in his play.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E5 Movie Show 1988 Ep 5 An episode featuring Christian Bale discussing his role in Empire of the Sun and Wendy Hughes reflecting on portraying a prostitute in Warm Nights on a Slow Moving Train.

programme.title: Hotel Salvation
programme.desc: Rajiv is forced to drop everything in order to accommodate his father's last and bizarre wish to travel to Varanasi to attain salvation. The trip that follows forces the duo to re-engage with each other and the world around them in this heart-warming comedy.

programme.title: Tokyo Story
programme.desc: An elderly couple travels from the countryside to Tokyo to visit their grown children, only to find them busy and emotionally distant. As quiet disappointments surface, a family tragedy reveals the costs of modern life and changing values. A gentle, deeply moving classic.

programme.title: The Longest Week
programme.desc: Left broke and homeless by his wealthy parents' divorce, a young man moves in with an old friend and finally meets the woman of his dreams.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: In 1593, struggling playwright Will Shakespeare finds inspiration and love with Lady Viola, who disguises as a man to act in his play.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E6 Movie Show 1988 Ep 6 Margaret and David review Slamdance, Couch Trip, Overboard, Repentance and doco Cannibal Tours, with film news, festival highlights and the premiere of Pandemonium.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: S12 E8 Joseph Cotten Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the 'golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: Limelight
programme.desc: Depressed over her failed dance career, a despondent ballerina attempts to take her own life, only to be rescued by an impoverished, once-famous stage clown. The comedian helps revive the dancer's health and prospects, and in the process recovers his own self-esteem as well. Directed by and starring Charlie Chaplin. Also stars Claire Bloom, Nigel Bruce and Buster Keaton.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Crooked House
programme.desc: When a wealthy tycoon is poisoned in his own bed, Detective Charles Hayward is invited to solve the gruesome crime. He is shocked to discover that one of the key suspects is the tycoon's beautiful granddaughter Sophia, his former lover. Hayward must keep a clear head to navigate Sophia and the rest of her hostile family in a case where nobody is above suspicion. Stars Max Irons and Stefanie Martini.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock and George Clooney star in Gravity, a thriller where two astronauts are stranded in space after their shuttle is destroyed. Running out of oxygen, they must fight to survive.

programme.title: Misery
programme.desc: The story of best-selling author, Paul Sheldon, who is on his way back home after finishing his latest novel. Meet Annie Wilkes, Paul's self-proclaimed number one fan, who takes it upon herself to nurse him back to health. After reading through one of his manuscripts, however, all hell breaks loose and nothing is ever the same again. Stars James Caan and Kathy Bates.

programme.title: Thelma & Louise
programme.desc: In one of the greatest road movies of all time, two women embark on a crime spree across the American south-west.

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: A neurologist and an old friend head to a deserted seaside town to identify a body. Strange nights and buried emotions turn a simple task into something unsettling and profound.

programme.title: The Girlfriend Experience
programme.desc: A drama set in the days leading up to the 2008 Presidential election, and centred on a high-end Manhattan call girl meeting the challenges of her boyfriend, her clients, and her work.

programme.title: Limelight

programme.title: The Remains of the Day
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins plays a devoted English butler reflecting on a lifetime of service, lost love, and loyalty as he realizes too late the cost of his blind duty.

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: Black Swan follows the story of Nina, a ballerina in a New York City ballet company whose life, like all those in her profession, is completely consumed with dance. She lives with her retired ballerina mother, Erica, who zealously supports her daughter's professional ambition. When artistic director Thomas Leroy decides to replace prima ballerina Beth MacIntyre for the opening production of their new season, Swan Lake, Nina is his first choice. But Nina has competition - a new dancer, Lily, who impresses Leroy as well. Swan Lake requires a dancer who can play both the White Swan with innocence and grace, and the Black Swan, who represents guile and sensuality. Nina fits the White Swan role perfectly but Lily is the personification of the Black Swan. As the two young dancers expand their rivalry into a twisted friendship, Nina begins to get more in touch with her dark side with a recklessness that threatens to destroy her.

programme.desc: S10 E11 Newtown 'Hat Factory', NSW Warehouse living in the buzzy inner city! For Anita and Kris Martincic it was a long held dream after years living and raising their children in Sydney's suburban south. So when a 100 year old derelict building known as the Newtown Hat Factory comes on the market, they jump in - dazzled by its potential and the chance for a sophisticated life of music, art and great restaurants. But there's an enormous amount of work to be done first! This ruin of a building was once a squat inhabited by some of Newtown's more colourful characters, but now it is barely standing, with crumbled, falling down walls and rotten floors. With grand ambitions and starry-eyed excitement they finally get underway rebuilding the hat factory, but what starts as an interesting architectural challenge, soon becomes a nightmare of endless delays and relentless cost blowouts. With the stresses and the bills mounting, Anita and Kris are forced to consider what it is they value most - the old hat factory or their health.

programme.title: Outback Truckers
programme.desc: S3 E1 Episode 1 The outback is one of the world's last wild frontiers and, for the giant trucks who roam this epic, harsh country, there's only one way to get from A to B - the hard way. Whether it's taking on scorching deserts, or battling torrential rains that turn roads into rivers, this is a land that can destroy in a heartbeat. For the men and women who risk their rigs and their lives to face it, this punishing wilderness is a home away from home. We hit the road train again for lots of dirt and dangers, joining some of the toughest, most skilled truckers on the planet, as they haul their massive loads through hell on Earth. Without them, Australia would grind to a halt. Their mission: to get their freight in and their trucks out. Turbo's on a mission as he takes the biggest gamble of his career. Steve Grahame battles 2000 km of dirt, damage and dramas at the wheel of a monster load. Glen Waters faces disaster. In Townsville, Queensland, long-distance trucker Peter gets ready for a cross-country haul in which he has to move a mixed freight through bush, farmland and desert to Darwin.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: S9 E5 Power Trip For two months out of every year, a group of exceptional men find their way to the Canadian tundra to undertake one of the most dangerous jobs on earth. In the thick of winter, truckers in giant eighteen wheelers carry vital equipment and supplies to miners hundreds of miles away. In blizzard conditions, these truckers travel over ice roads that often take them over frozen lakes. Each man is trained in self survival, from fixing his truck in sub zero conditions in seconds to escaping from a truck if the ice cracks. On the other end of the journey are miners whose lives depend on the truckers making it to their base, year after year. The episodes will form a narrative arch - taking the viewer on a journey from when the experienced and novice truckers first sign up for the season, to the last truck making it back to base.

Keith's got a rather sensitive penis complaint that he's keen to sort out. Dr Christian soon diagnoses Peyronie's disease. Realising the severity of this particular case, Dr Christian sees surgery as the only option, and refers Keith on to a urological surgeon whom he hopes can straighten things out. Keith meets consultant urological surgeon Mr Paul Anderson to discuss options. With advice from his surgeon, Keith opts for a Nesbitt's procedure which removes tissue from the unaffected side of the penis so that things balance out when sewn back up, even if slightly shorter. After a two-hour procedure, Keith's penis is corrected, with Dr Christian recommending that he waits a few months before seeking further treatment for his excess foreskin.

programme.title: Mary Berry at 90: A Lifetime of Cooking
programme.desc: S1 E3 Jamie Oliver Mary is joined by her kindred spirit, the globally renowned chef Jamie Oliver. Both have a love of cooking simple and delicious family food, and so together they prepare some of Mary's family favourites. Featuring the classic mushroom-stuffed watercraft chicken that she has been making for 30 years; an updated way to make lamb with a rich spiced tagine; a delectable prawn curry that makes the best of an ingredient that is far more accessible now than in the 1970s; and a favourite of Mary's, the incredible lemon drizzle cake. Between the recipes, Dame Mary and Jamie take a trip down memory lane with a look at Mary's first time cooking lemon drizzle cake on TV for the nation, more than 50 years ago, before sneaking off to the pub to enjoy a heartfelt chat and a very competitive game of table football.

Both have a love of cooking simple and delicious family food, and so together they prepare some of Mary's family favourites. Featuring the classic mushroom-stuffed watercraft chicken that she has been making for 30 years; an updated way to make lamb with a rich spiced tagine; a delectable prawn curry that makes the best of an ingredient that is far more accessible now than in the 1970s; and a favourite of Mary's, the incredible lemon drizzle cake. programme.title: Death Row Stories
programme.desc: S3 E3 Sabrina Butler In 1989, Sabrina Butler, a 17-year old woman, arrived at a Columbus Mississippi hospital with her baby, Walter Jr, who was pronounced dead on arrival. The nurses and doctors noticed various marks on the child's body and became suspicious of foul play. The police were called and Sabrina couldn't give a straight description of what happened to her baby. Eventually, she signed a confession that she had punched her child out of frustration. The autopsy report confirmed that a blow to the stomach had killed the baby. Sabrina was charged with capital murder, found guilty and sentenced to death. Several years later, British-born attorney and death penalty case expert Clive Stafford Smith took on Sabrina's case. Clive uncovered a corrupt system in Mississippi in which medical examiners would manipulate autopsies and scientific evidence to buttress the claims of law enforcement and prosecution. In Sabrina's case, specious medical analysis and overzealous law enforcement and prosecutors led to her conviction.

programme.desc: S7 E36 All Charged Up The city of Philadelphia was being plagued by a serial rapist, and then the crimes stopped. They started again, this time, in Fort Collins, Colorado. Colorado police had fingerprints and a DNA profile, but neither matched those in their databanks. programme.title: Death Row Stories
programme.desc: S3 E3 Sabrina Butler In 1989, Sabrina Butler, a 17-year old woman, arrived at a Columbus Mississippi hospital with her baby, Walter Jr, who was pronounced dead on arrival. The nurses and doctors noticed various marks on the child's body and became suspicious of foul play. The police were called and Sabrina couldn't give a straight description of what happened to her baby. Eventually, she signed a confession that she had punched her child out of frustration. The autopsy report confirmed that a blow to the stomach had killed the baby. Sabrina was charged with capital murder, found guilty and sentenced to death. Several years later, British-born attorney and death penalty case expert Clive Stafford Smith took on Sabrina's case. Clive uncovered a corrupt system in Mississippi in which medical examiners would manipulate autopsies and scientific evidence to buttress the claims of law enforcement and prosecution. In Sabrina's case, specious medical analysis and overzealous law enforcement and prosecutors led to her conviction.

programme.title: Grand Designs Australia
programme.desc: S10 E11 Newtown 'Hat Factory', NSW Warehouse living in the buzzy inner city! For Anita and Kris Martincic it was a long held dream after years living and raising their children in Sydney's suburban south. So when a 100 year old derelict building known as the Newtown Hat Factory comes on the market, they jump in - dazzled by its potential and the chance for a sophisticated life of music, art and great restaurants. But there's an enormous amount of work to be done first! This ruin of a building was once a squat inhabited by some of Newtown's more colourful characters, but now it is barely standing, with crumbled, falling down walls and rotten floors. With grand ambitions and starry-eyed excitement they finally get underway rebuilding the hat factory, but what starts as an interesting architectural challenge, soon becomes a nightmare of endless delays and relentless cost blowouts. With the stresses and the bills mounting, Anita and Kris are forced to consider what it is they value most - the old hat factory or their health.

In the thick of winter, truckers in giant eighteen wheelers carry vital equipment and supplies to miners hundreds of miles away. In blizzard conditions, these truckers travel over ice roads that often take them over frozen lakes. Each man is trained in self survival, from fixing his truck in sub zero conditions in seconds to escaping from a truck if the ice cracks. On the other end of the journey are miners whose lives depend on the truckers making it to their base, year after year. The episodes will form a narrative arch - taking the viewer on a journey from when the experienced and novice truckers first sign up for the season, to the last truck making it back to base.

programme.title: Outback Truckers
programme.desc: S3 E1 Episode 1 The outback is one of the world's last wild frontiers and, for the giant trucks who roam this epic, harsh country, there's only one way to get from A to B - the hard way. Whether it's taking on scorching deserts, or battling torrential rains that turn roads into rivers, this is a land that can destroy in a heartbeat. For the men and women who risk their rigs and their lives to face it, this punishing wilderness is a home away from home. We hit the road train again for lots of dirt and dangers, joining some of the toughest, most skilled truckers on the planet, as they haul their massive loads through hell on Earth. Without them, Australia would grind to a halt. Their mission: to get their freight in and their trucks out. Turbo's on a mission as he takes the biggest gamble of his career. Steve Grahame battles 2000 km of dirt, damage and dramas at the wheel of a monster load. Glen Waters faces disaster. In Townsville, Queensland, long-distance trucker Peter gets ready for a cross-country haul in which he has to move a mixed freight through bush, farmland and desert to Darwin.

programme.title: Ice Vikings

Chris shows off the skyhook prototype to his crew, a device he created to self-rescue his bombers if stuck, but the results are less than perfect. In what might be an historical first, mother and son fishing team, Candace and Alec Pishke, head out onto the ice. Justin and Mike make a terrible decision while towing a critical piece of equipment. programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: S9 E5 Power Trip For two months out of every year, a group of exceptional men find their way to the Canadian tundra to undertake one of the most dangerous jobs on earth. In the thick of winter, truckers in giant eighteen wheelers carry vital equipment and supplies to miners hundreds of miles away. In blizzard conditions, these truckers travel over ice roads that often take them over frozen lakes. Each man is trained in self survival, from fixing his truck in sub zero conditions in seconds to escaping from a truck if the ice cracks. On the other end of the journey are miners whose lives depend on the truckers making it to their base, year after year. The episodes will form a narrative arch - taking the viewer on a journey from when the experienced and novice truckers first sign up for the season, to the last truck making it back to base.

programme.title: Embarrassing Bodies
programme.desc: S3 E1 Cardiff In this episode, the team takes to the streets of Cardiff, with the help of dentist extraordinaire James Russell, rounding up ailments left, right and centre, but first Dr Christian has a visit at the clinic from ambulance technician Keith. Keith's got a rather sensitive penis complaint that he's keen to sort out. Dr Christian soon diagnoses Peyronie's disease. Realising the severity of this particular case, Dr Christian sees surgery as the only option, and refers Keith on to a urological surgeon whom he hopes can straighten things out. Keith meets consultant urological surgeon Mr Paul Anderson to discuss options. With advice from his surgeon, Keith opts for a Nesbitt's procedure which removes tissue from the unaffected side of the penis so that things balance out when sewn back up, even if slightly shorter. After a two-hour procedure, Keith's penis is corrected, with Dr Christian recommending that he waits a few months before seeking further treatment for his excess foreskin.

Both have a love of cooking simple and delicious family food, and so together they prepare some of Mary's family favourites. Featuring the classic mushroom-stuffed watercraft chicken that she has been making for 30 years; an updated way to make lamb with a rich spiced tagine; a delectable prawn curry that makes the best of an ingredient that is far more accessible now than in the 1970s; and a favourite of Mary's, the incredible lemon drizzle cake. programme.desc: Beca is that girl who'd rather listen to what's coming out of her headphones than what's coming out of you. Arriving at her new college, she finds herself not right for any clique but somehow is muscled into one that she never would have picked on her own: alongside mean girls, sweet girls and weird girls whose only thing in common is how good they sound when they sing together, in the out-loud comedy Pitch Perfect. When Beca takes this acoustic singing group out of their world of traditional arrangements and perfect harmonies into all-new mash-ups, they fight to climb their way to the top of the cutthroat world of college a cappella. This could wind up either the coolest thing they'll ever do or the most insane, and it will probably be a little of both.

After a scandal threatens to derail their last year at Barden, the three-time defending champs worry that they've lost their harmony for good. With one chance left at redeeming their legacy, they must they must face off against the toughest competition on the planet: German supergroup Das Sound Machine and fight for their right to win at the World Championships of A Cappella. It will take the power of sisterhood to find their voice and see what it takes to be the world's top pitches!

The local police aren't used to much action until the son of unassuming town snowplough driver, Nels Coxman, is murdered at the order of Viking, a flamboyant drug lord. Fuelled by rage and armed with heavy machinery, Nels sets out to dismantle the cartel one man at a time, but his understanding of murder comes mainly from what he read in a crime novel. As the bodies pile up, his actions ignite a turf war between Viking and his long-standing rival White Bull, a soulful Native-American mafia boss, that will quickly escalate and turn the small town's bright white slopes blood-red.

programme.desc: In the year 2154, two classes of people exist: the very wealthy, who live on a pristine man-made space station called Elysium, and the rest, who live on an overpopulated, ruined Earth. The people of Earth are desperate to escape the planet's crime and poverty, and they critically need the state-of-the-art medical care available on Elysium - but some in Elysium will stop at nothing to enforce anti-immigration laws and preserve their citizens' luxurious lifestyle. The only man with the chance bring equality to these worlds is Max, an ordinary guy in desperate need to get to Elysium. With his life hanging in the balance, he reluctantly takes on a dangerous mission - one that pits him against Elysium's Secretary Delacourt and her hard-line forces - but if he succeeds, he could save not only his own life, but millions of people on Earth as well.

But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, this group of awesome nerds will come together to make some music, and some questionable decisions, one last time.

programme.desc: Robin Hood, the legendary figure of 13th century England, who along with his band of marauders confront corruption in the local village of Nottingham and lead an uprising against the crown that will forever alter the balance of world power. Whether regarded as thief or hero, one man from humble beginnings will become an eternal symbol of freedom for his people.

programme.title: Maria

programme.title: Depravity

programme.desc: The Jurassic World theme park lets guests experience the thrill of witnessing actual dinosaurs, but something ferocious lurks behind the park's attractions - a genetically modified dinosaur with savage capabilities. When the massive creature escapes, chaos erupts across the island. Now it's up to Owen and Claire to save the park's tourists from an all-out prehistoric assault.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious
programme.desc: On the turbo-charged streets of Los Angeles, every night is a championship race. With nitro-boosted fury, Dominic Toretto rules the road, turning all his challengers into dust. He and his rival, Johnny Tran, are the boldest, the baddest, and the best, but now there's new rage on the road. They know he's tough, they know he's fast, but what they don't know is that he's a speed demon detective with enough drive and determination to come out the winner.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: The year is 1936, Indiana Jones hears from a museum curator named Marcus Brody about a biblical artefact called The Ark of the Covenant, which can hold the key to humanly existence. Joined with Marion Ravenwood and Sallah, Jones ventures to vast places such as Nepal and Egypt to find this artefact. He will have to fight his enemy Belloq and a band of Nazis for the Lost Ark.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: A sports agent suddenly discovers his scruples and promptly loses his job. But with the help of one loyal colleague and one outrageous client, he learns that loving well is the best revenge.

programme.title: Watchmen: Chapter I
programme.desc: In an alternate world, the murder of a government sponsored superhero draws his outlawed colleagues out of retirement, into a mystery that threatens their lives and the world itself.

programme.title: Watchmen: Chapter II
programme.desc: Former heroes face threats. The Comedian is dead, Dr. Manhattan exiled to Mars, Ozymandias survived an attack and Rorschach is arrested.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Former CIA analyst Jack Ryan travels to London with his wife and child. Upon being caught in the middle of a terrorist attack on a member of the royal family, Ryan helps to thwart the assailants. Ryan's courageous act, however, marks him and his family as a target for revenge in the sights of the terrorist whose brother Ryan killed.

programme.title: The Best Christmas Pageant Ever
programme.desc: Nobody is ready for the mayhem and surprises that ensue when six of the worst youngsters disrupt the town's yearly Christmas performance.

programme.title: Wicked
programme.desc: In Oz, two clashing witches, Elphaba and Glinda, form an unlikely friendship. Elphaba, wrongly labeled wicked, seeks to expose the corrupt Wizard ruling the land.

programme.title: The Lost City
programme.desc: Loretta Sage's novels are filled with ancient tombs and daring adventures, but that doesn't mean she's prepared for them in real life. When she is kidnapped by an eccentric billionaire to locate a legendary lost city, Loretta's handsome cover model, Alan, sets off on a heroic but hapless rescue mission. Thrust into an epic thrill-ride through the jungle, the unlikely pair must work together to survive the elements, and survive each other, to find the city's fabled treasure before it's lost forever.

programme.title: Salt
programme.desc: Phillip Noyce directs Angelina Jolie as Evelyn Salt, a CIA officer who swore an oath to duty, honour and country. When she is accused by a defector of being a Russian sleeper spy, Salt goes on the run to clear her name and ultimately prove her loyalty. Using all her skills and years of experience as a covert operative, she must elude capture and protect her family or the world's most powerful forces will erase any trace of her existence. With her superiors convinced she's out to assassinate the president, she also must race the clock to learn the identity of the real traitor.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: Nerdy college student Columbus has survived the plague that has turned mankind into flesh-devouring zombies because he's scared of just about everything. Gun-toting, Twinkie-loving Tallahassee has no fears. Together, they are about to stare down their most horrifying challenge yet: each other's company.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: Forced into slavery by the corrupt heir to the throne, Roman general Maximus becomes a gladiator. His prowess in the arena leads him to Rome, the Colosseum, and a showdown with the new emperor.

programme.title: Bullet Train
programme.desc: Ladybug, is an unlucky fixer determined to do his job peacefully after one too many gigs gone off the rails. Fate may have other plans, as Ladybug's latest mission puts him on a collision course with 10 deadly and diverse assassins, all with connected, yet conflicting objectives and tests his newfound philosophy in this non-stop thrill ride through modern-day Japan.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: After barely escaping a raging Shanghai nightclub brawl, Indy crash-lands into the wilds of India where he uncovers a sinister scheme that has enslaved a remote village's children in a fortress-like mine. Indy must save the children and avoid becoming a slave himself to the evil Thuggee cult.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible
programme.desc: There's a traitor in the heart of America's most secret spy network, the Impossible Mission Force. He or she is trying to steal IMF's critical agent list which would give America's enemies the names of every covert operative in the world. When a mission goes badly wrong, agent Ethan Hunt (Cruise) is suspected of being the turncoat and becomes a hunted man. With all the might of IMF now turned against him, Hunt must flush out the real traitor - even if that means stealing the secret list himself.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Detective Nick Curran's investigation of a rock star's brutal murder leads him to glacial beauty and best-selling author Catherine Tramell. Despite Nick's entanglement with police psychologist Dr Beth Garner and the ever-present Roxy, Catherine's sultry and possessive girlfriend, the two begin a torrid affair. But when Nick discovers that Catherine's fictional, murderous storylines have a habit of coming true, he begins to wonder if his attraction to Catherine might turn out to be a fatal one.

A wanted man on the run, Will must find those responsible, clear his name and somehow rescue his family who is trapped inside the building above the fire line.

programme.title: How Do You Know

programme.desc: Henry lives an enviable life in a Hawaiian paradise, spending every night with a beautiful tourist in search of an island fling. Has his karma come around to kick him in the butt, or what? Actually, Lucy has short-term memory loss, so every night all memory of her day is erased, but a man in love will go to any lengths to win over the girl of his dreams, and if that means having to find imaginative ways of doing it over again every day, then Henry's up for the challenge.

programme.title: Harold and the Purple Crayon

programme.title: Sylvanian Families: A Gift from Freya

programme.title: The Tale of Despereaux

Banished from his home for having such lofty ambitions, Despereaux sets off on an amazing adventure with his good-hearted rat friend Roscuro, who leads him, at long last, on a very noble quest to rescue an endangered princess and save an entire kingdom from darkness. Based on the heart-warming, bestselling children's book and featuring the voice talents of an all-star cast, this film is a magical, modern fairytale that's destined to win the hearts of young and old alike.

programme.title: Shaun The Sheep Movie: Farmageddon

With the help of Jeff, his faithful dog, an intrepid teacher, a mute parrot and a hustler, they will try to save the mythical Lost City of the Incas from an evil band of treasure hunters.

programme.title: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa

The precariously repaired craft stays airborne just long enough to make it to the African continent. There the New Yorkers encounter members of their own species for the first time. Africa proves to be a wild place, but Alex and company wonder if it is better than their Central Park home.

programme.title: Open Season 3
programme.desc: Boog plans an annual hunting trip for his woodland buddies but they choose family obligations which made Boog take a trip on his own leading him to a circus. He meets with Alistair a devious grizzly who wants to get out of the circus so he convinces Boog to switch places for his life in the wild for Alistair's place at the circus. While attending, Boog then falls for an alluring troupe member. Then the greedy circus ringmaster takes advantage of Boog by causing him misery and humiliation. When Boog's pals finds out about his disappearance, they hatch a rescue mission to rescue Boog and his true love.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Peter Rabbit, the mischievous and adventurous hero who has captivated generations of readers, now takes on the starring role of his own cute, contemporary comedy with attitude. In the film, Peter's feud with Mr. McGregor escalates to greater heights than ever before as they rival for the affections of the warm-hearted animal lover who lives next door.

programme.title: Dr. Seuss' the Lorax
programme.desc: Dr. Seuss' The Lorax is an adaptation of Dr. Seuss' classic tale of a forest creature who shares the enduring power of hope. In the walled city of Thneed-Ville, where everything is artificial and even the air is a commodity, a boy named Ted hopes to win the heart of his dream girl, Audrey. When he learns of her wish to see a real tree, Ted seeks out the Once-ler, a ruined old businessman outside of town in a stark wasteland. Upon hearing of how the hermit gave into his greed for profits and devastated the land over the protests of the Lorax, Ted is inspired to undo the disaster. However, the greedy Mayor of Thneed-Ville, Aloysius O'Hare, has made his fortune exploiting the environmental collapse and is determined to stop the boy from undermining his business.

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie
